name: stress-ng munmap
description: Start N stressors that exercise unmapping of shared non-executable mapped regions of child processes (Linux only). The unmappings map shared memory regions page by page with a prime sized stride that creates many temporary mapping holes. One the unmappings are complete the child will exit and a new one is started. Note that this may trigger segmentation faults in the child process, these are handled where possible by forcing the child process to call _exit. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
